title: eleogenus ovatus
intro: Eleogenus ovatus, commonly known as New Zealand pepper tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Maori medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Eleogenus ovatus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, and its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
